# Independent Office workbook fixtures

`preview.xls` is the Harness-authored synthetic `Office preview 中文文档`
document exported with LibreOffice 26.8.0.3's Excel 97 filter. Source:
<https://github.com/deepseek-harness/libreoffice-kit/tree/main/test/fixtures>.
The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`.
SHA256: `311df8fcb797cfeffb552f254a054976ab61611d4a2cf68cd11f3ae7e2a73d37`.

`test/office-workbook-fixtures.cjs` independently serializes OPC XML/ZIP and
a BIFF5/CFB fixture. It uses Node zlib and literal expected contents, never the
workbook parser under test. Its codepage 936 bytes `D6 D0 CE C4` mean `中文`.
These are parsing and rendering samples, not evidence of full Excel fidelity.

## Independently authored rich samples

`rich.docx`, `rich.pptx`, `rich.xlsx`, `rich-1904.xlsx`, and `missing-font.docx`
are generated by `test/office-preview-fixtures.cjs` using pinned `docx` 9.7.1
for Word and independently serialized OPC XML/ZIP for slides and workbooks.
All text and the deterministic checker PNG were authored for this project
under its ISC license (the repository `LICENSE`). These new samples do not
derive from the Harness fixture or change its retained MIT license.

Run `node test/office-preview-fixtures.cjs <output-directory>` to reproduce
the new-format inputs. ZIP timestamps and Word core dates are fixed. The
Word files have three explicit pages, mixed Chinese/Latin text and styles,
a table, an embedded PNG, and PAGE footer fields. Slides have three explicit
slide IDs: text layout, image layout, and a table layout. Workbooks include
two visible sheets, hidden and veryHidden sheets, 1900/1904 date systems,
date/currency/percent formats, theme colors, bold/italic, borders, merges,
row heights, column widths, and saved formula caches. The deliberately stale
`1+1` cache is 99; it must not be silently recomputed by a preview reader.

`rich.doc`, `rich.ppt`, and `rich.xls` were independently exported from these
inputs by full LibreOffice 26.8.1.1 (`bf6ef2662401c7d6dce671ab4deb26ee0af3a7c1`),
using the `MS Word 97`, `MS PowerPoint 97`, and `MS Excel 97` export filters.
The XLS uses BIFF8 Unicode; the separate BIFF5 fixture above tests CP936.
LibreOffice may update volatile or shared formula caches during authoring;
the XLS expectations in `rich-manifest.json` bind the committed output.

`golden-rich-{doc,docx,ppt,pptx}.pdf` are independent full-LibreOffice PDF
exports from the corresponding committed inputs. Each has three pages,
per-page literal landmarks, a table, and an image. They are reference
observations bound to the source hashes, never outputs of the application
kit under test. PDF metadata, fonts, and rendering can vary between authoring
machines; regenerated PDF byte equality is not a fidelity requirement.

`rich-manifest.json` records input/golden hashes, literal authoring facts,
tool version, and the official signed MSI provenance. Reproduce legacy and
PDF exports with a separate full LibreOffice, a fresh private UserInstallation
profile, and synthetic files only, for example:

```text
soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///absolute/private/profile --headless --nologo --nodefault --norestore --convert-to "doc:MS Word 97" --outdir output rich.docx
soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///absolute/private/profile --headless --nologo --nodefault --norestore --convert-to "ppt:MS PowerPoint 97" --outdir output rich.pptx
soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///absolute/private/profile --headless --nologo --nodefault --norestore --convert-to "xls:MS Excel 97" --outdir output rich.xlsx
soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///absolute/private/profile --headless --nologo --nodefault --norestore --convert-to pdf --outdir golden rich.doc
```

Use distinct output directories for PDFs with the same `rich` basename.
No authoring suite, installer, system font, profile, or local log belongs in
the source distribution. These inputs establish controlled reading cases;
they do not establish complete Word, PowerPoint, or Excel fidelity.
